description.text: The second Sun & Moon set, released on 5 May 2017 with 169 cards: 145 and 24 secret rares, ten more than Sun & Moon, which made it the record holder at the time. It gathers cards from the Japanese sets Islands Await You, Alolan Moonlight and Strength Expansion Pack Sun & Moon and the Rockruff Full Power Deck. The island guardians Tapu Koko-GX and Tapu Lele-GX lead its 12 Pokémon-GX, all of which have secret-rare versions, and secret-rare Decidueye-GX, Incineroar-GX and Primarina-GX, left out of the English Sun & Moon, join them. Kahuna Hala and Captain Mallow are among its three full-art Supporters.
